population: Only clear/approximate labels; missing candidates remain in denominators and are reported separately
pairedPopulation: Audible objects with a finite e5CalibratedErrorMs; no imputation for missing candidates
timeDiagnostics: Spearman correlation of signed residual against referenceMs within each sample and within each redline with at least three pairs; no regression or correction
foldContrasts: Report odd/even paired medians within the same redline when each fold has at least two pairs; no additional fitting
histogram: 5 ms wide signed-error bins centered on multiples of 5 ms, diagnostic only
interpretationPolicy: Large residual is not by itself proof of a wrong peak; redline medians, within-group spread, fold contrasts and time order must be considered together
nextRulePolicy: Choose at most one E6 mechanism after inspecting this decomposition; do not tune thresholds on confirmation data
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
